citations.claim: tangential x-velocity reverses and more than doubles despite e<1
first violation: energy jumps ~80J at wall contact with no controller work

counterfactual.change: changed body restitution e from 0.9369 to 0.0 (one field); inelastic impact removes bounce energy gain so no violation

explanation: Body moves toward the thin wall corner (distance_to_surface 0.15 at step 3) and contacts it during step 4. Despite e=0.937<1 and zero controller work, speed rises 30.80->33.29 and energy 493.05->573.49J. The x-component reverses and amplifies 11.21->-24.95 (2.2x), indicating the corner/edge impulse adds energy instead of dissipating it (e.g., wrong contact normal or over-correction at box corner coupling tangential component into bounce).
vision_note: The blue circle moves upward toward the left tip of the thin horizontal wall over steps 1 to 3. In step 4 it contacts the sharp corner end and appears stuck at the tip rather than bouncing cleanly away.
